en.headline: A hot day: drink water through the day
body: Drink water often today, before you are thirsty.
If your doctor set a limit, keep to it.
Stay out of the midday sun.
Get help if you feel dizzy or weak.
en.passage: If your doctor has limited how much fluid you should drink, follow that advice.

ms.headline: Hari panas: minum air sepanjang hari
body: Minum air selalu hari ini, sebelum rasa haus.
Jika doktor anda beri had, ikut had itu.
Dapatkan bantuan jika anda rasa pening atau lemah.
ms.passage: If your doctor has limited how much fluid you should drink, follow that advice.

zh.headline: 天气很热：整天都要喝水
body: 今天常常喝水，不要等到口渴。
如果医生给您定了喝水的量，就照着做。
如果头晕或没力气，就找人帮忙。
zh.passage: If your doctor has limited how much fluid you should drink, follow that advice.
